'''Asadia Boresa''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] who lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], Asadia Boresa lived on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where she worked at the [[Senate Commercial District]] below the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. A [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]], Boresa passed on her knowledge to others searching to learn the skill.<ref name="TOR" />
